summary: Rick Santorum won yesterday evening's Louisiana Republican primary, a victory said to give him more leverage over fellow presidential hopeful Mitt Romney; Santorum has 263 delegates to Romney's 563. Santorum has also won primaries in Mississippi, Alabama, Tennessee and Oklahoma, and political analysts and the press speculated he would take Louisiana based on the conservative and religious voter base, with participating voters polled as believing Santorum was more conservative and moral than Romney. The next primaries will be in Wisconsin, Washington, D.C., and Maryland on April 3.
